title: say in the UI brief that a go test -run pattern must not contain a pipe and offer a form that is allowed

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The ui reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261125-153042-530c, project ork, item S547:

say in the UI brief that a go test -run pattern must not contain a pipe and offer a form that is allowed

Evidence: go -C ... test -run MatrixCopy|RenderCLIViews ./internal/cli was denied as "multiple operations"
